dedupe_keys.name: integrated model for transmission and resource adequacy imtra

description: Integrated Model for Transmission and Resource Adequacy (IMTRA) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Maon GmbH. The IMTRA model integrates probabilistic and deterministic methods to assess the electricity system security of supply. Probabilistic indicators evaluate the adequacy of variable resources (such as wind, solar PV, storage, and natural gas imports) under uncertainty. Deterministic parameters assess long-range electricity transmission from generation to consumption through the grid. Coverage: Denmark, Hungary, Lithuania, Latvia, Poland. Methodical focus: Dispatch, Stochastic. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: continents. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
